description: Implementation of a pluggable allocator for XPU devices in PyTorch, including memory management, stream recording, and allocator initialization.

classes.name: XPUPluggableAllocator
classes.description: A customizable memory allocator for XPU devices supporting dynamic memory management and stream operations.

methods.name: malloc
methods.description: Allocates memory on the specified device with given size and queue.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates memory and returns a DataPtr for use in PyTorch.

methods.name: raw_alloc
methods.description: Allocates raw memory of specified size.

methods.name: raw_deleter
methods.description: Returns a function pointer for raw memory deletion.

methods.name: raw_delete
methods.description: Deletes memory pointed to by ptr, updating metadata.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the allocator with device count.

methods.name: initialized
methods.description: Checks if the allocator has been initialized.

methods.name: copy_data
methods.description: Copies data between memory locations using the current XPU stream.

methods.name: recordStream
methods.description: Records a stream for the given DataPtr.

methods.name: emptyCache
methods.description: Functionality not yet supported; raises an error.

methods.description: Functionality not yet supported; raises an error.

methods.description: Functionality not yet supported; raises an error.
